name: 75 Waterbury Avenue
desc: Charming 2 bedroom,2 full bath townhouse (2nd and 3rd floor). Excellent condition!! Beautiful eat in kitchen with center island, ceiling fan .First floor has hardwood floors, 2nd floor has carpeting. water views of Holy Pond.... Near Cove Island... tenants MUST have excellent credit.

name: 79 Highview Avenue
desc: Tucked away, set back from the road, this 5 unit complex has all the right ingredients. Open concept living room & dining space, with fireplace and hardwood floors. Deck with private setting. Tri-level townhouse with finished large lower level with washer & dryer, slider leading to the patio at grade level. Parking for 2 cars in the oversized paved lot. Easy access to all conveniences, schools, shopping, trains, restaurants, and both Merritt Parkway and I95. Springdale location has neighborhood charm & ease of casual lifestyle, near Darien border.

name: 82 Columbus Place
desc: Spacious 3 bedroom, 3.5 bath townhome built in 2020 and impeccably maintained, one of three side by side homes in the desirable Springdale neighborhood of Stamford. The main level is anchored by a large living room with fireplace and an open kitchen and dining area with direct access to a private patio, plus a balcony and a convenient powder room. The bedroom level features a primary suite with two walk in closets and a spa inspired bath with double vanity, along with two additional bedrooms and a full hall bath. The lower level offers a family room with a full bath, ideal as a playroom, home office, or guest bedroom. Hardwood floors, a 2 car garage, and central air complete the home. Commuters will love being 5 minutes from the Springdale train station, about 60 minutes to Grand Central, with easy access to both the Merritt Parkway and Interstate 95 and supermarkets close by. Move right in.

name: 83 Highland Road
desc: Tucked away in the pulse of exciting downtown Stamford, you'll find this special slice of heaven! Very spacious, immaculate and bright with everything you could ever want, this garden style apartment features lush views from the balcony, a sunny open flow, living room with wood burning fireplace, large master bedroom, reserved garage parking, central air, amazing storage inside and a separate storage room in the garage. Relax in the enchanting courtyard with tranquil fountain surrounded by beautiful greenery. Come see this inviting sanctuary located in the heart of the sophisticated city where you can stroll to popular restaurants, bars, theater, library and shopping.

name: 833 Summer Street
policy: allowed=true; allowed_pets=not stated | amenities: Pet friendly
desc: Enjoy the convenience of downtown Stamford living in this top-floor corner unit. This well-maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bath residence offers 837 sq. ft. of comfortable living space with hardwood floors throughout. The inviting living room features a fireplace, while the spacious kitchen offers a window for natural light and ample room for everyday dining. Both bedrooms are generously sized with excellent closet space, and a full-size washer and dryer are conveniently located within the unit. The rent includes hot water, one reserved parking space, and additional storage. Ideally located near Stamford Town Center, restaurants, parks, public transportation, and the Metro-North station. Pets may be considered on a case-by-case basis. Excellent credit required.

name: 85 Riverside Avenue

desc: Welcome to Extended Stay America - Norwalk - Stamford! We are the perfect location for business travelers, students, tourists and those relocating to the Norwalk, CT area who need to find a home away from home for several nights, a week, a month or even longer. Our hotel is conveniently located off the Merritt Parkway. From our location, you can easily visit local attractions such as The Maritime Aquarium at Norwalk, Cove Island, West Beach and the Stamford Town Center. When you stay at an Extended Stay America hotel, youll enjoy just the right amenities to make you feel at home. All our spacious suites feature amenities like fully equipped kitchens, free grab-and-go breakfast, free wi-fi and plenty of space to work, dine and relax. We also offer on-site guest laundry, an on-site fitness center and pet-friendly rooms. Here at Extended Stay America, genuine care is who we are. Book your stay with us today!

desc: The Beacon offers a peaceful balance of tranquility and connection. Just off of Westport Ave, you can enjoy easy commutes and access to all the wonderful shopping and dining that the charming Fairfield County is known for. Yet, nestled back amongst the trees, away from roads, each home is a sanctuary of natural beauty. Destress from your day on the rooftop lounge, hanging out poolside, meditating in the yoga room, or walking through 2 acres of dedicated conservation area along the community. The Beacon's suite of amenities gives you plenty of social spaces and quiet places to unwind. Whether you'd rather indulge in a night in or experience the town, this is the perfect home base for the lifestyle you crave. Conveniences like the electric car charging stations and onsite dog park and pet spa make life uncomplicated. Modern interiors with designer finishes elevate every apartment home without excess, creating an attainable level of comfort and luxury unparalleled in the surrounding area.

name: 304 Lexington Avenue
desc: Sunny and inviting second-floor unit in a well-maintained two-family home. The spacious layout features a large entry foyer that opens to the living room, formal dining room with a charming bay window, and an updated eat-in kitchen with granite countertops, gas stove, hood, dishwasher, and large new fridge. Three bedrooms and an updated marble bathroom with double-sink vanity. Enjoy your own private balcony. New replacement thermal pane windows. The large backyard is shared with the first-floor tenants. Basement provides additional storage and washer/dryer hookups. Good credit score (700 or above), references and credit/criminal check required.

name: 31 Blake Street - 3
desc: Spacious and stunning 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment Parking available - large backyard perfect for relaxation and entertainment Enjoy classic New England charm on Blake Street in this multi-family home just off central New Haven streets. The building features a welcoming covered front porch and an upper covered balcony, plus a side driveway for off-street parking and a modest front yard with trimmed hedges. Interiors offer a well-equipped galley kitchen with a gas range, over‑range microwave, full-size refrigerator, ample wood cabinetry and durable countertops. A full bathroom includes a tub/shower and vanity. Bright living spaces have multiple windows and warm wood‑tone floors that maximize natural light. Schedule a showing to see this property in person. Walking distance to Edgewood Park and Whalley Ave shops and restaurants. Short drive to the State Street train station.

The third floor features and additional living area, third full bathroom and a large bedroom.

name: 33 Stevens Street
policy: allowed=true; allowed_pets=not stated | amenities: Pet friendly
desc: This spacious first-floor two-bedroom apartment offers approximately 900 square feet of comfortable of living space with a functional layout and plenty of natural light. The spacious eat-in kitchen features a subway tile backsplash, new stainless steel gas range and hood, ample cabinet space, and room for a dining area. Both bedrooms are a generous size & the full bathroom includes a tub/shower combination. Additional conveniences include off-street driveway parking and basement laundry hookups, with tenants providing their own washer and dryer. Conveniently located in New Haven with easy access to downtown, Yale New Haven Hospital, major highways, shopping, dining, and public transportation. Available for immediate occupancy. Minimum 620 credit score required, household income must be at least 2x the monthly rent, credit/background check required, no smoking, and 1 small pet considered at the landlord's discretion & additional fee.

name: 34 Beers Street
desc: Enjoy modern comfort and everyday convenience at 34 Beers Street, New Haven. Available November 1, this modern renovated two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment offers approximately 1,200 square feet of living space, with high ceilings, new windows, and thoughtfully updated finishes throughout. The spacious kitchen features stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and a generous island with seating for four; an inviting place for morning coffee, casual meals, or unwinding at the end of the day. Two fully renovated bathrooms, an in-unit washer and dryer, and one off-street parking space add to the ease of daily living. Located just one block from Yale New Haven Hospital's Saint Raphael Campus, this apartment puts the hospital close to home while offering a comfortable space to recharge. Listing agent is part owner Applicants should have a credit score of 675 or higher and verifiable income. Satisfactory rental history and references will be requested and verified. Rentspree application required, $35 fee

A fantastic opportunity to live in one of New Haven's most sought-after neighborhoods!

Conveniently located just 10 minutes from Yale University, downtown New Haven, and Union Station with easy access to I-95 and I-91.

name: 1412-1414 Dixwell Avenue
desc: AVAILABLE IMMEDIATELY! This charming 2nd-floor two-bedroom, one-bath apartment offers comfortable living with ELECTRICITY, HEAT, and WATER INCLUDED. The two generously sized bedrooms each feature his-and-hers closets, and large, newly installed vinyl windows with wood trim bring in abundant natural light. Rich brown-toned, plank hardwood floors add warmth and character throughout the main living areas. A spacious family room/den provides an inviting retreat, complete with built-ins, a ceiling fan, and wall-to-wall carpeting. The kitchen features modern appliances and convenient functionality. The full bathroom features a tub/shower combination and laminate flooring. A welcoming apartment with plenty of natural light, storage, and comfortable living space-ready for immediate occupancy. A yearly lease, credit check, references, renter's insurance, and a one-month security deposit are required. Convenient access to the bus line, shopping, and plazas. The unit is approximately 900 sq ft.

name: 1769 Dixwell Avenue
desc: This completely updated 3-bedroom, 1-full-bath unit, conveniently located above Venice Bakery, offers a bright and inviting place to call home. The open floor plan provides a wonderful flow between the spacious living room and dining room, making the space comfortable for both everyday living and entertaining. Gorgeous hardwood floors, abundant natural light, and exceptional trim details add warmth and character throughout. The apartment has been thoughtfully updated and is move-in ready. Additional features include off-street parking and a common laundry area for added convenience. You'll also love the location, just minutes from highways, shopping, restaurants, and everyday amenities. A credit score of 650 or above is a must. No pets allowed.

name: 19 First Street
desc: Fully renovated 2 bedroom apartment featuring a spacious layout, updated kitchen and bathroom, new finishes throughout, hardwood floors and spacious bedrooms. Off-street parking and washer/dryer available on-site. Conveniently located near shopping, transportation, and local amenities. Move-in ready!

name: 26 Cumley Street
desc: Well-maintained single-family rental offering comfortable living space with hardwood floors, a separate dining area, a spacious kitchen, and a backyard. Utilities are included in the monthly rent. Conveniently located near public transportation, major highways, shopping, and everyday services. Serious inquiries only. Schedule a showing for additional information and rental requirements.

name: 32 Alstrum Street
desc: Spacious and well-maintained 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom first-floor unit located on a quiet residential street in Hamden. This bright and inviting apartment features generously sized bedrooms, a comfortable living area, and an updated kitchen with ample cabinet space. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, parks, public transportation, and major highways, making commuting easy. Enjoy the charm of a neighborhood setting while remaining close to everyday amenities. Don't miss this opportunity to make this comfortable rental your next home!

name: 52 Fourth Street
desc: Situated in an established Hamden neighborhood, this charming single-family home offers a practical layout and exceptional convenience for daily living. The welcoming interior features bright living spaces highlighted by large windows that bring in steady natural light throughout the day. A functional kitchen provides great cabinet storage and workspace, transitioning smoothly into a comfortable dining area perfect for mealtime gatherings. The bedrooms serve as cozy private retreats with ample closet space. Outside, the property includes a manageable yard ideal for fresh air, gardening, or weekend relaxation, alongside off-street parking. Positioned just minutes from Southern Connecticut State University, Albertus Magnus College, local parks, shopping, and public transit, this home offers central access to downtown New Haven, Yale University, and major commuter routes.

name: 632 Circular Avenue
desc: Beautiful single-family ranch-style home located in a desirable area, featuring 3 bedrooms, 1 full bathrooms, a spacious kitchen, living room, dining room, and an additional room perfect for a home office or extra bedroom. The property also offers additional finished living space in the basement, a large backyard, an attached garage, and private parking. A wonderful place to call home.

name: 84 Lexington Street - 2
desc: Spacious 2-Bedroom, 1 Bathroom Apartment - $1,850/Month Beautiful, spacious apartment with 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, and separate living room, dining room, and kitchen areas. Both bedrooms offer plenty of closet space, with 2 closets in each bedroom and an additional walk-in closet in one. This apartment also features beautiful hardwood floors, plenty of natural light, and a comfortable layout with lots of room to enjoy. Rent: $1,850/month All are welcome to apply! Message me for more information or to schedule a showing.

name: 900 Mix Avenue
desc: Welcome to this spacious and nicely maintained, 2 bedroom, 1 and 1/2 bath condo ready immediately for rent! The unit flows from living room, into the dining room, and right into the kitchen! The primary bedroom has a walk-in closet, and direct access into the full bath, which can also be accessed from the hallway. Enjoy the ease of living with vinyl flooring, and the convenience of in-unit washer and dryer. A slider in the living room leads onto the balcony that overlooks a lovely wooded area. The condo complex community in-ground swimming pool is close by, for easy access, to enjoy on warm summer days! Centrally located in Hamden, minutes to shopping, restaurants, schools, and highways! No pets, and no smoking!

name: 12 Cedar Court
desc: Welcome to 12 Cedar Court, Unit D, located in the desirable Birches at Foxon community in East Haven! name: 2 Irving Place
desc: Spacious three-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse offering plenty of room to feel at home! The main level features hardwood floors and a generous, open living space with plenty of room for both living and dining. Upstairs, you'll find three nicely sized bedrooms with brand-new carpeting and a full bath. The large unfinished basement provides additional storage and includes laundry for added convenience. Off-street parking and a convenient location close to shopping, restaurants, major roadways, and everyday amenities make this a great place to call home. The landlord does not guarantee the washer and dryer. They are there for the tenant to use, but will not be replaced should they fail.

name: 21 Cottage Street
desc: Beautiful location with off-street parking. One-car garage available for $175/month additional cost per month. First floor apartment is freshly painted and gleaming inside with nice floors. Two bedrooms and one nice bathroom. Eat-in kitchen, dining room, and living room. Plenty of room to find a quiet corner. The wraparound front porch reminds me of very nice days visiting my grandmother with plenty of room for a hammock or two.

name: 30 Smith Street
desc: Spacious and clean 4-bedroom rental offering a flexible and functional layout with 2 bedrooms upstairs and 2 bedrooms on the main floor. The main floor features a full bath, large living room and an eat-in kitchen with plenty of space for everyday dining. Generous closet and storage space throughout. The upper level has been updated with new carpeting. Conveniently located with access to public transportation. A comfortable, well-maintained home with plenty of room to spread out.

name: 4 Orchard Street
policy: allowed=true; allowed_pets=not stated | amenities: Pet friendly
desc: Welcome home! Pets Welcome and Parking available! This beautiful second-floor ranch-style apartment offers a clean, bright, and inviting space with two generously sized bedrooms and two entrances for convenience. The open kitchen and adds a fresh, modern feel, while abundant natural light creates a warm and welcoming atmosphere throughout. Conveniently located near major highways and just minutes from downtown Danbury, this apartment offers both comfort and convenience. Come see all it has to offer and make this wonderful space your own!
